heading: Proof of rent arrears
paragraphs: As your claim is on the grounds of rent arrears, you must now answer questions about:
bullets: how much the rent is and how often it should be paid
how much the arrears were on the date you served notice, if you served notice
how much the rent arrears are today
afterBullets: You must also provide proof of how the rent arrears have built up over time. You can either upload a rent statement or create one in this service.
The defendants will be able to see your answers and any documents you upload.
